# Decisions: boopada-planner

- 2026-09-15T08:51:53.724Z — rule: **Never put a decimal string or float money value in an API request or response — always {amount_minor, currency} integer minor units.** — chose **Money in the API is always {"amount_minor": integer, "currency": "ISO code"} in the currency's minor units (JPY/VND exponent 0, JOD 3), in both request and response bodies** over Decimal strings or floats, as the providers quote and as the earlier prototype used because The prototype's decimal strings made totals drift. Integer minor units are exact, and provider QuotedPrice values are converted at the boundary in lib/money.ts.
- 2026-09-15T08:51:57.853Z — rule: **Reject any interest that is not one of the seven provider activity categories; never accept free text.** — chose **Interests are exactly the providers' seven activity categories: culture, food, nature, adventure, nightlife, wellness, tour** over Free-text interest tags because Interests have to join against Activity.category from @workspace/providers for suggestions (roadmap 7) and the advisor (roadmap 8); free text would never match. Anything else is rejected with 400 invalid_interest.
- 2026-09-15T08:52:03.769Z — rule: **Open SQLite only through apps/web/lib/db.ts — never import bun:sqlite or node:sqlite directly.** — chose **One SQLite handle opened through createRequire: bun:sqlite under Bun, node:sqlite under Node, behind a tiny Db interface in apps/web/lib/db.ts** over Importing bun:sqlite directly, or better-sqlite3 because Bun 1.3.14 has no node:sqlite and Next.js runs under Node 24 (which has no bun:sqlite), so the app and `bun test` need different modules. A static import of bun:sqlite breaks the Next build; createRequire hides the specifier from the bundler and stays synchronous. better-sqlite3 would add a native build step.
- 2026-09-15T08:58:25.277Z — rule: **Never reach a Node builtin that Turbopack externalises (node:sqlite) via import or createRequire in apps/web — use process.getBuiltinModule.** — chose **Load node:sqlite through `process.getBuiltinModule("node:sqlite")` under Node, and bun:sqlite through `createRequire` under Bun** over createRequire for both, which D3 originally chose because Turbopack traces require() even through createRequire and rewrote node:sqlite into an external it then could not load: `next build` succeeded but every request to /api/profile died with "Cannot find module 'node:sqlite': Unsupported external type Url for commonjs reference". `process.getBuiltinModule` is opaque to the bundler. The bun:sqlite branch is safe under createRequire because it only ever runs under Bun, which does not bundle. Verified with `bun run build` then `bun run start`.
- 2026-09-15T09:03:21.453Z — rule: **Never hard-DELETE a traveller-made row or ask for delete confirmation — soft-delete through softDelete() in apps/web/lib/deletions.ts, and filter `deleted_at is null` in every list, total and suggestion.** — chose **App-wide soft delete: every traveller-made table has a nullable `deleted_at`; deleting stamps it AND appends a row to a `deletions` log (seq autoincrement, entity, entity_id, deleted_at, undone_at), both in one transaction, via `softDelete()` in apps/web/lib/deletions.ts. POST /api/undo takes the highest-seq un-undone log row, clears the entity's `deleted_at`, stamps `undone_at` and returns { restored: { entity, id, item } }; with none it is 409 `nothing_to_undo`. Repeated undo walks back through older deletions (a stack). Every list/total/suggestion/lookup query filters `deleted_at is null`; PATCH/DELETE on a deleted row is 404.** over Hard DELETE with a confirm dialog; a per-feature trash table; ordering undo by deleted_at timestamp because The traveller decided: nothing they made is ever hard-deleted and nothing asks "are you sure?". One log across all entities makes "the most recent deletion" well defined app-wide. Ordering is by log seq, not timestamp, because BOOPADA_NOW freezes the clock so every deletion in a test shares one timestamp. Future entities (trips, days, to-dos) register their table in SOFT_DELETABLE and a reader in lib/undo.ts; a cascading delete should log ONE row for the parent and stamp children with the same deleted_at so undo restores the whole group.
- 2026-09-15T09:03:25.747Z — chose **Bucket item shape: { id (integer), title, city_id | null, notes | null, estimated_daily_spend: Money | null, created_at, updated_at }; route is /api/bucket (not /api/bucket-list as the previous next-action said). city_id validated with providers.locale.getCity → 400 `unknown_city`; spend validated like the profile budget (integer minor units, known currency, non-negative). PATCH is partial: absent = unchanged, null clears optional fields, title cannot be cleared. GET lists oldest first (created_at, id).** over Free-text city names; decimal-string spend; PUT full replace because The user's spec names /api/bucket and PATCH edits; city ids must join against provider cities for trips and suggestions later; D1 governs money.
